super in Constructor

bugs.explanation: In a derived class constructor, `super()` must be called before `this` is accessed. Accessing `this.radius` before calling `super(color)` throws `ReferenceError: Must call super constructor in derived class before accessing 'this'`.

Object.assign Deep Copy Limitation

bugs.explanation: `Object.assign` performs a shallow copy. Nested objects are still shared by reference, so mutating `copy.a.b` also mutates `orig.a.b`. Use `structuredClone(orig)` (or `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(orig))`) for a deep copy.
